name: Fino Payments Bank Ltd
title: Fino Payments Bank Ltd - 543386 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue down 31% YoY and digital UPI P2M business paused with active clients down to 229 from 347; CASA accounts 1.75 crore (+22%), but the business is in a governance-led retrenchment with no formal FY27 guidance.

triggers.label: UPI P2M business paused; clients 347→229
triggers.quote: our active client base declining from 347 in December'25 to 229 in March'26

triggers.label: B2B digital throughput down ~17% QoQ
triggers.quote: Throughput from B2B digital payments were down approximately 17% sequentially in Quarter 4'26.

triggers.label: No FY27 guidance; ROE 20% target by FY30
triggers.quote: we're not putting currently any guidance

triggers.label: Record March account openings 3.2 lakh
triggers.quote: we opened 3.2 lakh new accounts. Yes, this is 3.2 lakh new accounts, highest in last 3 years.

guidance.quote: the ROE of 20% is what we aim to achieve by FY'30
we are looking at around 300 basis point advantage on our cost of funds
we've quoted around ₹100 crores is primarily around the technology infrastructure enhancement

red_flags.label: Senior management unavailable; RBI fit-and-proper review
red_flags.quote: Mr. Rishi Gupta being unavailable for more than 45 days

red_flags.label: UPI P2M business paused, merchant base cut
red_flags.quote: we have decided to pause the UPI P2M business

red_flags.label: Interim CEO and CFO; special review of product and process
red_flags.quote: We are doing a special review of the product and process in contention.

red_flags.label: Depreciation and interest step-up; PAT down
red_flags.quote: the impact gets larger is because of the investment which we've done

evasions.quote: I'm not commenting or giving -- divulging the numbers of April currently.
we are technically not requiring to have capital
we'll just keep an updated on the entire business model in later part of the quarter
